zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.5-beta.4** 补上无头 CLI：`peer exec` 可按提供方消歧模型；不传 `--max-turns` 时不人为截断。
前台 shell 会记住当前目录和环境；`read_file` 可按行范围读取。
思考栏默认收起，编辑器菜单图标和箭头不再丢。
文档站 Changelog 已同步本版说明。

zh.title: 新功能
items: 新增 `peer exec`：不打开 TUI，直接在当前目录跑一轮 Agent。
`peer exec` 按提供方消歧模型名，避免同名模型选错。
前台 `local.shell.exec` 在同一会话里保持 cwd 和环境。
`read_file` 支持 `start_line` / `end_line`，按行返回带行号的切片。

zh.title: 优化
items: `peer exec` 未传 `--max-turns` 时不再默认截断。
工作集内的工具结果保持内联，避免被挤出当前上下文。

zh.title: 修复
items: 思考栏默认收起，展开前不再闪实时思考条。
编辑器菜单图标改回本地 icns，不再空白。
装饰箭头改为线性 SVG，不再靠字符凑合。
TUI 在省略 `--max-turns` 时正确传入无上限，而不是悄悄截断。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本版 GitHub Release 附带 CLI 归档（与 Desktop 同 tag / 同版本）。
可通过 `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`（或 `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`）安装 beta 通道版本；`postinstall` 会拉取本版归档。
也可手动解压归档，将目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 校验后运行 `peer`。
CLI 与 Desktop 继续共享 `~/.peer-agent` 下的会话和设置。

en.title: Overview
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.5-beta.4** adds headless CLI: `peer exec` disambiguates models by provider and does not cut the run unless you pass `--max-turns`.
Foreground shells keep cwd and env across calls; `read_file` can return a numbered line range.
The thinking ticker stays collapsed until you expand it; editor menu icons and arrows no longer go missing.
The docs changelog is in sync with this release.

en.title: Features
items: Add `peer exec` to run one Agent turn from the current directory without opening the TUI.
Disambiguate `peer exec` model names by provider so same-named models do not collide.
Persist cwd and env for foreground `local.shell.exec` inside one conversation.
Let `read_file` accept `start_line` / `end_line` and return a numbered slice.

en.title: Improvements
items: Leave `peer exec` unbounded unless `--max-turns` is set.
Keep working-set tool results inline so they stay in the current context.

en.title: Fixes
items: Hide the live thinking ticker until the thinking block is expanded.
Restore editor menu icons from local icns instead of leaving them blank.
Replace character arrows with linear SVG icons.
Pass an unbounded turn limit when TUI `exec` omits `--max-turns`.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release ships CLI archives under the same tag and version as Desktop.
Install the beta channel with `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta` (or `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`); `postinstall` downloads this release's archive.
Alternatively, unpack an archive manually, add its directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version`, and then run `peer`.
CLI and Desktop continue to share sessions and settings under `~/.peer-agent`.
